dev-placement.rubric: Use the prior idea and supplied beacon counts. A clarification asks a consequential placement question; a proposal is movable and preserves the page before confirmation.

dev-ambiguous.rubric: Ask which of the two identical sentences or sections the author intends; do not assume a target.

dev-creative-names.rubric: Provide ten distinct usable name options suited to the user-supplied character; do not treat the speculative backstory as established fact or modify the page. The supplied premise is sufficient; no discovery or source reads are required.

dev-research.rubric: The answer reports two copper pieces on market days and is supported by the actual ledger read.
